shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.emergencyQuitHint: Closes Hat completely even when it's not focused. Useful if something freezes or you need to hide the app quickly.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Switches the whole interface. The AI starts responding in the chosen language (unless you customized the system prompt).

ai.promptChangedToast: Custom prompt kept — edit it manually if you want answers in {{language}}.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.captureImagesHint: Copied images (screenshots, prints) are also sent to the AI along with the text.
clipboard.appendModeHint: The original text is kept, with the response added below, separated by "---".

flash.title: Flash Mode
flash.flashModeHint: The response is "flashed" discreetly at the position below instead of opening a system notification.
flash.positionHint: Click Adjust and drag the window to the ideal position.
flash.durationAutoHint: Time adapts to the response length.
flash.textShadowHint: Adds a subtle outline so the text doesn't vanish on bright backgrounds.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.osNote: Display time is controlled by the operating system.
